title: PRESENCE (The Seventh Discipline)
style: minimalist electronic, focused still male vocal NZ/AU accent, single melodic line repeating with subtle variations, no unnecessary production, the music is present with itself, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 88 BPM
lyrics:
``
[VERSE 1]
Flow state in the coding run
Mindfulness before the day's begun
Zen — just this — just now — just here
The boardroom quiet — three words clear

Not the past — not the plan
Not the version of yourself you scanned
Just the breath — just the room
Just the moment — not the doom

[CHORUS]
Presence is the discipline
The A.I. cannot fake
Presence is what the human brings
To every choice we make
Now is the only moment
The stack runs — you decide
Presence is the transformation
From reaction — to inside

[OUTRO]
Put the phone down.
Just for now.
Now is enough.
